description: BTS ATRI Freight Mobility Initiative: County-to-county truck travel times (2021) - Experimental is a dataset listed in data.bts.gov (Bureau of Transportation Statistics open data), an open data portal of the Bureau of Transportation Statistics under the section "Trucking and Motorcoaches", published or maintained by Bureau of Transportation Statistics. Experimental estimates of the travel times experienced by a sample of freight trucks observed moving between all county pairs in the United States over the course of calendar year 2021. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Trucking and Motorcoaches". It has 11 columns, among them Year, 25th Percentile (minutes), Destination CTFIPS, 50th Percentile (minutes), Movements, Origin CTFIPS. The portal shows 2026-01-06 as the last data update. Attribution given: Bureau of Transportation Statistics. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-bts-data-bts-gov-portal.
